description: Client-side script for managing BOM (Bill of Materials) form in ERPNext, including setup, validation, cost calculations, and related operations.

classes.name: BomController
classes.description: Controller class extending erpnext.TransactionController for BOM-specific logic, including conversion rate and item code handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form queries and setup for BOM form.

methods.name: onload_post_render
methods.description: Sets up multiple add feature for items grid.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh actions, button setup, and indicators.

methods.name: make_work_order
methods.description: Creates a work order from BOM.

methods.name: setup_variant_prompt
methods.description: Displays a prompt dialog for variant item creation.

methods.name: make_quality_inspection
methods.description: Opens a mapped Quality Inspection document.

methods.name: update_cost
methods.description: Calls server method to update BOM costs.

methods.name: rm_cost_as_per
methods.description: Sets conversion rate to 1.0 if valuation or last purchase rate is selected.

methods.name: routing
methods.description: Fetches routing details and recalculates costs.
